profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Disney Cruise Line
profile.summary: Senior technology and product leader with over two decades at The Walt Disney Company, including deep experience in Disney Cruise Line, delivering and modernizing enterprise digital, data, and operational platforms at scale. Proven at defining strategy, governance, and operating models while leading cross-functional teams across engineering, product, architecture, and operations. Known for translating complex business domains into durable, reusable platform capabilities that improve reliability, efficiency, and guest experience across distributed, high-volume environments. Trusted partner to senior leadership, balancing near-term delivery with long-term platform value through pragmatic architecture, strong decision frameworks, and a focus on scalable, auditable outcomes.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, Disney Cruise Line Online, Disney Parks, Experiences, & Products
positions.description: Delivering easy, intuitive digital experiences for all our online Guests worldwide to confidently book and enjoy their perfect vacation with the trust and quality they expect from Disney Parks and Resorts.

positions.title: Technical Java Team Lead, Walt Disney Parks & Resorts Technology
positions.description: Support and ongoing development of 40+ enterprise applications surfaced on the company's internal employee facing portal.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Walt Disney Parks & Resorts Online
positions.description:
Building portals to magical travel destinations including the Walt Disney World Resort in Florida and the Disneyland Resort in California.

As a Senior Software Engineer, and Certified Scrum Master, on one of the "Lodging & Sales Studios" deliver PHP front-end and Java middle-tier components in support of ongoing enhancements of the My Disney Experience online platform.

As a Senior Software Engineer on one of the Agile "Commerce Studios" contributed to the delivery of the Disneyland Mobile Tickets site (http://disneylandmobiletickets.com) and the Next Generation My Disney Experience site for the Walt Disney World Resort (http://disneyworld.com). Built Java RESTful services in support of the payment and checkout portion of the Guests' eCommerce experience. Delivered resilient, PCI compliant software components which integrate with third-party systems for credit card validation, verification, and authorization as well as vacation booking and ticket purchases. Supported the launch and ongoing sustainment of the next generation platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead client centric delivery efforts for Java, iOS, and SFDC based solutions. Coordinated delivery efforts, including documentation, testing, and and deployment. Contributed to the design and development of client applications. Performed project management tasks including time and resource tracking and reporting.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, developed, implemented, and delivered the next generation StrikeTracker application, a Flex based Rich Internet Application with a Java middle-tier and a MySQL backend, which aims to provide an integrated control console that allows customers to manage their Content Delivery Network services.

positions.title: Principal Business Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Developed and enforced architectural standards, for Information Technology Architecture Strategy & Innovation, as they applied to the use of new technologies within the enterprise as well as changes to existing systems. Contributed to various enterprise-wide efforts including the specification of requirements for standards solutions in the CRM, web chat, workflow automation, and messaging space as well as remediation of existing applications for CSI Compliance. Actively participated in the peer review process for various internal publications including Vision, Strategy, and Pattern documents which when accepted became a part of our corporate Architecture Standards. Responsible for providing guidance to the BPDs and BAs through the RFI and RFP processes to insure that overall architectural goals were met by any solution adopted and deployed within certain technological spaces.

Designed, developed, implemented, maintained, and supported the Titan case management applications, for Global Enterprise Support Advanced Support Technologies, including the Titan Rich Client, Titan Services, and Titan Web Tools, as well as other support applications and services leveraging various standard multi-tier Java application frameworks including J2SE (Java 5 & Java6), J2EE (including JSP and Servlet), JDBC, XML, JSP, HTLM, Spring, Hibernate, DTO, DAO, Apache Commons, DROOLS, jBoss and WeBlogic Application Servers, etc; also used SVN for source control, Jira for defect tracking, Ant and Maven for building and deploying applications, and Bamboo for continuous integration.

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description: As a member of the eLearning Support team I provided code-level support for various client-facing web-based applications including the my.hrw.com and my.eharcourtschool.com sites and their component applications. At the time the eLearning environment consisted of a mixture of deployment platforms including Sun Solaris 9 and 10, BEA Weblogic 5 and 8, IBM WebSphere 5 and 6, Oracle 9i and 10g, JRE 1.3 and 1.4. The applications used various technologies, frameworks, and patterns including Java, J2EE, .NET, JavaScript, EJB, JSP, Servlet, JSTL, XML, XSL, JXL, JAX, Struts, Spring, JDBC, MVC, DAO, DTO, log4J, Apache Commons, etc.

positions.title: Application Architect
positions.description: As an independent contractor to the Florida’s Turnpike Enterprise I contributed to the replacement and consolidation of two customer service applications: the Patron Account Workstation, a Delphi direct to Oracle application, used by customer service representatives in the SunPass call center and the SunPass.com application used for batch-based customer self service. Using Sun standard technologies including Sun’s Java Enterprise System, SunONE LDAP and Identity servers, Sun Java (J2SE) 1.4.2 and Sun’s commodity hardware platform as well as other industry standard frameworks including Apache Struts, log4j, XML, BPEL, UML I helped to document and construct a consolidated ‘real-enough-time’ customer service and account management application. I also contributed to the specification of a system for delivering host-based balance for the then-current tag-based active RFID toll collection system that was heavily dependent on batch processes between the account management system and the toll plazas and lanes. The new host-based system provides a service oriented infrastructure with legacy system integration and serves as the foundation for future initiatives including high-speed and open-road tolling as well tighter low-latency integration with interoperable partners for existing and future initiatives.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: I have worked on various enterprise initiatives and cross-business unit projects leveraging and integrating multiple technologies including J2SE, J2EE, MDB, EJB, JMS, JNI, JDBC, JAXB, JAXP, SAX, DOM, XML, XSL, JSP, HTML, DHTML, and JavaScript to integrate with various vendor solutions including Oracle, DB2, Informix, IBM WebSphere MQ, Epicentric Portal Framework, GoPublish, Inktomi Spider, and WebSphere Application Server to produce portable, extensible solutions. My development platform has typically been a Microsoft Workstation using a language appropriate IDE – VisualAge for Java, Satellite Forms, WebSphere Studio Application Developer, Visual Studio, Eclipse, XMLSpy, HomeSite – and my deployment environments have included Microsoft servers, PalmOS devices, and Solaris servers. I have participated in all stages of the software development lifecycle including analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, support, and sunset/end-of-life.
